# `load` check

Check the load average relative to the number of CPUs (not supported on Windows).

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: load
    window: 5m
    expect:
      per_cpu: { warn: 100%, fail: 200% }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | one of: 1m, 5m, 15m | `5m` | Which load average to use. |
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.per_cpu` | {warn, fail} percent | `{warn: 100%, fail: 200%}` | Load average divided by the number of CPUs (100% = one runnable task per CPU). Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check load [--set key=value ...]`
